=={{header|Omegese}}==
{{works with|omc|sha256 2c824805, aien-dev/omega-mv e5b32567, Linux AArch64}}
Omega has no imports, so the small output helpers (<code>emit</code> and friends) are part of the program.
<syntaxhighlight lang="text">
om2
text nl "\n"
text hexd "0123456789abcdef"
text m0 "abc"
text m1 "Rosetta Code"
text m2 "The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog"
text m3 "aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa"
global hs uint 5
global ww uint 80
global buf uchar 128
note emit writes every byte of a to stdout; a short write is retried, an error exits 1
fn emit a view uchar * to void
o = ulong 0
while lt o len a bound 4096
k = write 1 a o sub len a o
if le k 0
exit 1
end
o = add o ulong k
end
end
note emitc writes one byte
fn emitc c uchar to void
b = new uchar 1 0
put b 0 c
emit b
end
note emith writes the byte v as two lower-case hex digits
fn emith v uchar to void
emitc get hexd shr v 4
emitc get hexd and v 15
end
note rnd is step i of 80 on the state (a, b, c, d, e) in hs, with the expanded schedule in ww
fn rnd i ulong to void
a = get hs 0
b = get hs 1
c = get hs 2
d = get hs 3
f = uint 0
k = uint 0
if lt i 20
f = or and b c and not b d
k = 1518500249
else
if lt i 40
f = xor xor b c d
k = 1859775393
else
if lt i 60
f = or or and b c and b d and c d
k = 2400959708
else
f = xor xor b c d
k = 3395469782
end
end
end
t = add add add add rotl a uint 5 f get hs 4 k get ww i
put hs 4 d
put hs 3 c
put hs 2 rotl b uint 30
put hs 1 a
put hs 0 t
end
note block loads the 64 bytes of buf at p as 16 big-endian words, extends them to 80 and runs the steps
fn block p ulong to void
for w ulong 16
v = uint 0
for j ulong 4
v = or shl v 8 uint get buf add add p mul w 4 j
end
put ww w v
end
for w ulong 64
x = add w 16
v = xor get ww sub x 3 get ww sub x 8
v = xor v get ww sub x 14
v = xor v get ww w
put ww x rotl v uint 1
end
sv = new uint 5 0
for k ulong 5
put sv k get hs k
end
for i ulong 80
rnd i
end
for k ulong 5
put hs k add get hs k get sv k
end
end
note digest prints the five state words big-endian in hex
fn digest to void
for k ulong 5
v = get hs k
for j ulong 4
s = mul uint sub 3 j 8
emith uchar and shr v s 255
end
end
emit nl
end
note sha1 pads a (up to 119 bytes) with 0x80, zeros and the bit length (big-endian) to one or two
note 64-byte blocks, hashes them and prints the digest in hex
fn sha1 a view uchar * to void
put hs 0 uint 1732584193
put hs 1 uint 4023233417
put hs 2 uint 2562383102
put hs 3 uint 271733878
put hs 4 uint 3285377520
n = len a
for i ulong 128
put buf i 0
end
for i ulong n
put buf i get a i
end
put buf n 128
t = ulong 64
if ge n 56
t = 128
end
bits = mul n 8
for j ulong 8
put buf sub sub t 1 j uchar and shr bits mul j 8 255
end
for b ulong div t 64
block mul b 64
end
digest
end
fn main to int
note the empty message, as a slice of length 0
sha1 part m0 0 0
sha1 m0
sha1 m1
sha1 m2
sha1 m3
ret 0
end
